CompanyCredit.description: The CompanyCredit container displays company credit balance, credit limit, and outstanding balance for B2B companies with credit purchasing.

CompanyProfile.description: The CompanyProfile container manages company information including name, legal details, VAT/Tax ID, addresses, payment methods, and shipping methods.

CompanyRegistration.description: The CompanyRegistration container provides a form for new company account registration with company details, legal address, and administrator information.

CompanyStructure.description: The CompanyStructure container displays and manages the organizational hierarchy with teams, users, and their assignments within the company structure.

CompanyUsers.description: The CompanyUsers container manages company users with add, edit, remove, and status change functionality for user administration.

CustomerCompanyInfo.description: The CustomerCompanyInfo container displays the customer's current company association and available company information.

RolesAndPermissions.description: The RolesAndPermissions container manages user roles and permissions for controlling access to company features and operations.
